case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        FILE="ZenithProxy-launcher-linux-amd64.zip"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        FILE="ZenithProxy-launcher-linux-aarch64.zip"
        ;;
    *)

        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "Downloading $FILE..."

unzip -o launcher.zip

chmod +x launch
